 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 16 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) There is a time to stay and a time to transition. And now, Scorpio , this week, you know you must transition even if you feel like hanging on for a while longer. But you do realise that it doesn't serve you anymore. There is a lot you tend to pack in, and your guides insist that this week you take a break and pause to listen to your inner voice. You have been taking on more than you can handle, so drop the rope, Scorps. Breathe. You deserve a good life minus the guilt and nitpicking.
 Cosmic tip: Give yourself enough time to rest to reset your mental, emotional and physical health.
